_about.labeler: Claude Code agent (the same agent that wrote the questions); not a human. Labels were written after reading each served answer against the reference answer and BEFORE any judge verdict was produced. Rubric is identical to the judge prompt: correct = states the key fact(s) of the reference for the period asked, no wrong figure; missing an explicitly asked part = incorrect.

observations.heldout-haiku-cli/t08: Labelled correct, but the answer names KULR, which is not in its quote. The checker verifies numbers, not entities.
observations.heldout-ollama-qwen0.5b/t01: Labelled correct on content, but its three quotes do not support it (counts are written as words, so the number check cannot catch it).
observations.heldout-ollama-qwen0.5b/t17: Answer "15%" quotes a verbatim worked example from the BTC Yield definition: faithful quote, wrong answer.
observations.heldout-ollama-qwen0.5b/t19: Gives the three-month and six-month totals as if both were the quarter.
observations.heldout-extractive: Model-free sentence picker; incorrect items quote a real sentence that does not answer the question or omits an asked part.
